diagram_previews.alt: The larger circle with centre O and the small blue circle with centre O' tangent to it internally at K; the chord AB touches the small circle at T, dividing it into p and q, with the small circle on the far side of the chord from O.
The same circles with the small circle on the same side of the chord AB as O; the chord touches it at T near B, dividing it into a long part p and a short part q.

difficulty_rationale: Needs a coordinate set-up of two tangency conditions and the observation that the smaller circle can lie on either side of the chord, giving two values.
